parameters.content:
**Deal Stage Trigger & Event Classification**
This workflow begins whenever a HubSpot deal changes stage.

The incoming webhook is inspected to determine whether the deal has entered or exited one of the predefined Demo Attended stages used by the sales process.

Only relevant stage transitions continue through the workflow, while unrelated deal updates are ignored to reduce unnecessary processing and API calls.

**Contact Retrieval & Workflow Preparation**

Retrieve the latest deal information directly from HubSpot, including all contacts associated with the deal.

Before continuing, the workflow verifies that the deal is still in the expected stage to avoid processing outdated webhook events caused by rapid stage changes.

Each associated contact is then prepared as an individual workflow item so every contact can be processed independently. If no contacts are linked to the deal, the workflow records the event in the audit log and exits gracefully.

**Duplicate Prevention & Data Validation**

Before making any marketing changes, the workflow checks the execution history stored in Google Sheets.

Each contact and deal combination is compared against previous executions to determine whether the same Entry or Exit action has already been completed.

This prevents duplicate tag updates, repeated marketing actions, and unnecessary API requests if HubSpot sends the same webhook multiple times. Contacts with invalid email addresses are also excluded to prevent downstream failures.

**Marketing Automation Synchronization**

Depending on the current deal status, the workflow synchronizes the contact with Encharge.

When a deal enters the Demo Attended stage, the required marketing tag is added to enroll the contact into the appropriate nurture sequence.

When a deal exits the Demo Attended stage, the same tag is removed to ensure marketing automation always reflects the current sales pipeline status.

**Execution Audit Trail**

Every successful marketing update is recorded in the Google Sheets audit log.

The log stores the contact, deal, processed stage, execution timestamp, and applied classification, providing a complete history of workflow activity for troubleshooting, reporting, and future duplicate prevention.

**Failure Tracking & Operational Alerts**

If an Encharge request fails, the workflow records the failure, increases the retry counter, and updates the execution log.

When repeated failures exceed the configured threshold, an automatic email notification is sent to the team with the contact, deal, error details, and execution link so issues can be investigated quickly.

nodes.name: Code: Verify HubSpot Signature
nodes.notes: SECURITY (must fix before go-live): validates x-hubspot-signature-v3 so only genuine HubSpot requests can trigger tag changes. Requires: (1) 'Raw Body' enabled on the webhook node [already set], (2) HUBSPOT_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable configured in n8n, (3) testing the exact requestUri reconstruction against your real webhook URL.

parameters.content:
**Webhook Signature Verification (NEW)**

Validates HubSpot's x-hubspot-signature-v3 header (HMAC-SHA256 using the app's Client Secret) before any stage-change event is trusted. Requests older than 5 minutes or with a bad signature are rejected and alerted on, never processed.

SETUP REQUIRED: set the HUBSPOT_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable in n8n, and confirm the reconstructed request URI matches exactly what HubSpot signs for your instance before relying on this in production.

**Centralized Stage Configuration (NEW)**

ENTRY_STAGE_IDS / EXIT_STAGE_IDS now live in exactly one place - this node - instead of being duplicated in two Code nodes. If the client adds, removes, or renumbers a pipeline stage, update it here only.
